# Configuration reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/config-docs.ts from packages/core/src/config/schema.ts. Do not edit; run `pnpm docs:config`. -->

Every ReelForge Studio setting, generated from the one configuration schema.
Precedence, lowest to highest (D-029):

1. **default** (below)
2. **file**: the YAML or JSON file named by `REELFORGE_CONFIG`, nested by key
   (`limits.rateLimitPerMinute` is `limits: { rateLimitPerMinute: 120 }`); unknown keys are refused
3. **env**: the environment variables below; the `REELFORGE_` name wins over older aliases;
   every secret can also be read from a file named by `<NAME>_FILE` (Docker/Kubernetes secrets)
4. **runtime**: values set over the API (`PATCH /v1/config`, MCP `update_config`, admin scope), stored in the
   database; only settings with scope **runtime**. `null` clears a runtime value.

**Release images** (the published Docker image, D-039) fix `licence.mode` (`required`), `licence.serverUrl` and
`licence.orgId` at build time: their source is **build**, and a config file, environment variable or
`update_config` that tries to change them is refused (`build_locked_setting`). Builds from source (`pnpm dev`,
`--build-arg REELFORGE_EDITION=dev`) keep every setting configurable; `licence.mode: off` there is for
noncommercial development only (LICENSING.md).

Scope **startup** settings are read once at start; changing them at runtime is refused with an error that says
where to set them. `GET /v1/config` / MCP `get_config` show each effective value and its source; secrets show
only `set` / `not set`. Secrets set at runtime are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) with `REELFORGE_SECRET_KEY`;
without it the server refuses to store them. Check a configuration without starting the server:
`reelforge config check [--file PATH]`; print the effective one: `reelforge config show`.

Example `reelforge.yaml`:

```yaml
server:
  publicUrl: https://studio.example.com
limits:
  rateLimitPerMinute: 120
  renderConcurrency: 2
logging:
  level: info
```

## server

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server.host` | `REELFORGE_HOST` | string | `127.0.0.1` | startup |  | Bind address. Keep loopback unless a TLS proxy is in front (`0.0.0.0` in the Docker image). |
| `server.port` | `REELFORGE_PORT` | integer | `4321` | startup |  | TCP port (`0` picks a free one). |
| `server.publicUrl` | `REELFORGE_PUBLIC_URL` | url | (none) | startup |  | Public base URL: used in output links and allowed as Host on `/mcp`. Example: `https://studio.example.com`. |
| `server.allowedHosts` | `REELFORGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | list (comma-separated in env) | (empty) | runtime |  | Extra host names accepted on `/mcp` (DNS-rebinding protection), besides localhost and the public URL host. Comma-separated in the environment. Example: `reelforge,studio.internal`. |

## limits

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limits.rateLimitPerMinute` | `REELFORGE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | integer | `300` | runtime |  | Requests per minute per API key (`0` disables the limit). |
| `limits.maxUploadBytes` | `REELFORGE_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | integer | `209715200` | runtime |  | Largest asset upload or URL import, in bytes. |
| `limits.maxJsonBytes` | `REELFORGE_MAX_JSON_BYTES` | integer | `2097152` | runtime |  | Largest JSON request body, in bytes. |
| `limits.renderConcurrency` | `REELFORGE_RENDER_CONCURRENCY` | integer | `1` | runtime |  | Renders at the same time. Each uses several CPU cores and 1-2 GB RAM. A lower value lets running renders finish. |

## storage

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storage.dataDir` | `REELFORGE_DATA_DIR` | path | `./data` (`/data` in Docker) | startup |  | Asset and render files, caches, the URL signing key, and the SQLite database by default. |
| `storage.cacheDir` | `REELFORGE_CACHE_DIR` | path | `<dataDir>/cache` | startup |  | Engine bundle and provider result cache. |
| `storage.driver` | `REELFORGE_STORAGE_DRIVER` | `local` \| `s3` | `local` | startup |  | Where asset and render files are kept. Only `local` works today; `s3` is refused until #27 is built. |
| `storage.s3.bucket` | `REELFORGE_S3_BUCKET` | string | (none) | startup |  | S3 bucket. _(Reserved for #27.)_ |
| `storage.s3.region` | `REELFORGE_S3_REGION` | string | (none) | startup |  | S3 region. _(Reserved for #27.)_ |
| `storage.s3.endpoint` | `REELFORGE_S3_ENDPOINT` | url | (none) | startup |  | S3-compatible endpoint (MinIO, R2, ...). Empty for AWS. _(Reserved for #27.)_ |
| `storage.s3.accessKeyId` | `REELFORGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | (none) | startup | yes | S3 access key id. _(Reserved for #27.)_ |
| `storage.s3.secretAccessKey` | `REELFORGE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | (none) | startup | yes | S3 secret access key. _(Reserved for #27.)_ |

## database

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database.url` | `REELFORGE_DATABASE_URL`, `DATABASE_URL` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | `file:<dataDir>/reelforge.db` (SQLite) | startup | yes | Database: `file:` (SQLite), `postgresql://...`, `mysql://...` or `mariadb://...`. Secret because the URL usually holds a password. Example: `postgresql://reelforge:<password>@db:5432/reelforge`. |
| `database.migrateOnStart` | `REELFORGE_MIGRATE_ON_START` | boolean | `true` | startup |  | Apply pending migrations on start. Off: refuse to start while migrations are pending (run `reelforge migrate`). |
| `database.connectTimeoutSeconds` | `REELFORGE_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | integer | `30` | startup |  | Keep retrying the first database connection this long (a database container may still be starting). |

## security

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `security.secretKey` | `REELFORGE_SECRET_KEY` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | (none) | startup | yes | Encrypts secrets stored in the database (provider keys, licence key) with AES-256-GCM. At least 32 characters: `openssl rand -base64 32`. Without it the server refuses to store secrets. Keep it safe: losing it makes stored secrets unreadable. |
| `security.bootstrapKey` | `REELFORGE_BOOTSTRAP_KEY` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | (none) | startup | yes | First admin API key (`rf_` + 20 or more URL-safe characters). Stored hashed as key "bootstrap" on start if no key exists. |

## render

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `render.chromiumPath` | `REELFORGE_CHROMIUM_PATH` | path | (none; set in Docker) | startup |  | Chrome Headless Shell binary used by every engine. |
| `render.chromiumNoSandbox` | `REELFORGE_CHROMIUM_NO_SANDBOX` | boolean | `false` (`true` in Docker) | startup |  | Turn Chromium's own sandbox off (containers, where the container is the isolation boundary). |
| `render.ffmpegPath` | `REELFORGE_FFMPEG_PATH`, `FFMPEG_PATH` | path | `ffmpeg` on PATH | startup |  | FFmpeg binary (system build; 6.1 and 5.1.9 tested). |
| `render.ffprobePath` | `REELFORGE_FFPROBE_PATH`, `FFPROBE_PATH` | path | `ffprobe` on PATH | startup |  | ffprobe binary. |
| `render.backends.remotionLambda.region` | `REELFORGE_REMOTION_LAMBDA_REGION`, `REMOTION_LAMBDA_REGION` | string | (none) | runtime |  | AWS region of your Remotion Lambda deployment (backend `remotion-lambda`, not implemented yet: configuration check only). |
| `render.backends.remotionLambda.functionName` | `REELFORGE_REMOTION_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME`, `REMOTION_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME` | string | (none) | runtime |  | Remotion Lambda function name. |
| `render.backends.remotionLambda.serveUrl` | `REELFORGE_REMOTION_LAMBDA_SERVE_URL`, `REMOTION_LAMBDA_SERVE_URL` | url | (none) | runtime |  | Remotion Lambda serve URL (the deployed site). |

## providers

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `providers.elevenlabs.apiKey` | `REELFORGE_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | (none) | runtime | yes | Enables the ElevenLabs TTS provider. Same setting as `configure_provider` / `PUT /v1/providers/elevenlabs/config`; stored encrypted when set at runtime. |

## logging

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `logging.level` | `REELFORGE_LOG_LEVEL` | `debug` \| `info` \| `warn` \| `error` | `info` | runtime |  | Server log level. |
| `logging.format` | `REELFORGE_LOG_FORMAT` | `text` \| `json` | `text` | startup |  | `text` (`[reelforge] ...` lines) or `json` (one object per line). |

## licence

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Scope | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `licence.mode` | `REELFORGE_LICENCE_MODE`, `REELFORGE_LICENSE_MODE` | `required` \| `off` \| `trial` | `required` | startup |  | What happens without a valid licence (D-028). `required`: renders and previews are refused until a key is activated (everything else works). `off`: development and CI only; nothing is refused, a configured key is still checked and reported. `trial` is reserved and not built yet (behaves as `required`). |
| `licence.key` | `REELFORGE_LICENCE_KEY`, `REELFORGE_LICENSE_KEY` (each also as `_FILE`) | string | (none) | runtime | yes | Licence key from your ReelForge purchase (D-028). Activated on start and when set; validated daily. Setting it with `activate_licence` / `POST /v1/licence` stores it encrypted (needs `REELFORGE_SECRET_KEY`). Only the key and a random instance id are sent to the licence server (docs/PRIVACY.md). |
| `licence.offlineGraceDays` | `REELFORGE_LICENCE_OFFLINE_GRACE_DAYS` | integer | `14` | startup |  | Days the server keeps rendering past the last successful licence check while the licence server cannot be reached (D-028). At most 14; a lower value only shortens it. |
| `licence.serverUrl` | `REELFORGE_LICENCE_SERVER_URL` | url | `https://api.console.buildbase.app` | startup |  | Licence server (BuildBase). Change only for a mock server in tests. |
| `licence.orgId` | `REELFORGE_LICENCE_ORG_ID` | string | `6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8` | startup |  | BuildBase organisation that issued the key (ReelForge production). A test environment is `<orgId>-<environment key>`. |

## Not in the schema

| Env | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `REELFORGE_CONFIG` | Path of the config file (YAML or JSON). |
| Provider settings declared by plugins | Set with `configure_provider` / `PUT /v1/providers/:id/config` (stored encrypted, like `providers.*`) or the environment variable the provider names. |
| `HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY`, `DO_NOT_TRACK`, `CHECKPOINT_DISABLE` | Telemetry opt-outs for third-party tools, set in the Docker image. |
